title: Verify no duplicate task exists before creating a new one
body: Query by title or ticket number before POSTing a new task record. Silent filter failures (especially unencoded operators) cause duplicate-creation loops. A task number appearing twice signals a broken filter, not two different tasks.
source_ref: rules.md:R05; lessons — 'Task #68 duplication spam: Misty Phase 3 filter broken, causing 86+ duplicate tasks'
